correctness.rationale: The finite-abelian Weyl basis diagonalizes the projector orbit with eigenvalue q^2|A_g|^2. Planarity is exactly singleton graph overlap for all nonvertical translations; the missing vertical rows force a fixed maximal q^4-q^3+q^2 accessible subspace. The two smallest squared amplitudes bound translate ambiguity. If their product is at least (q+1)^(-2), the fully proved concentration lemma bounds the Fourier energy and Parseval forces a zero-shift nontrivial coefficient of magnitude at most 1/(q+1). Exact factorization of a cubic and positive lower-root inequalities for all q>=5 establish the lemma and its equality uniqueness. Planarity supplies flat beta-nonzero character sums, proving the one-heavy construction has all allowed values at least 1/(q+1). Full finite test over q=3,5,7,9 and independent projector eigenvalues for q=3 verify normalizations. No reliance on finite checking for infinite claims.

Exact best-possible conditioning of Gabor projector measurements on that space, all optimal window weights, and the universal q+1 analysis-condition law form a natural complete extremal-design result, uniform in every odd prime-power planar function. The sharp mass-concentration lemma and rigidity go beyond routine rank counting or table recomputation.
